verdict.rationale: Datalab supports processing large/multi-page documents via page_range segmentation, checkpointing to avoid re-parsing, pipelines to chain processors, webhooks for async job notification, and CLI/SDK access — all of which enable automation across multiple documents/items, and the runtime probe confirms a working CLI and API. However, there's no explicit evidence of a native batch/bulk submission endpoint (e.g., submitting many files in one call and getting a job array back) — users would need to loop API calls per document. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch submission API or docs showing many-item throughput in a single call, independent benchmarks of bulk job handling at scale.
